schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme. PDF 14 Paper 2 notes and reading annotation key; 15–16 Léamhthuiscint A; 17–18 Léamhthuiscint B; 19 literature annotation key; 20–24 Prós Ainmnithe (2A); 25–26 Prós Roghnach (2B); 27–30 Filíocht Ainmnithe (3A); 31–32 Filíocht Roghnach (3B); 33 modified marking (SMM; 34 is its Paper 1 table). reviewMethod: Visual inspection of every paper page (pages 1–3 cover with the COVID-19 adjustment note and instructions, 14–15 blank, 16 acknowledgements) and every applicable scheme page; cross-checked extracted text.

nonPoolDecisions: Reading: all ten questions are required; each printed (a)/(b) part is a 5-mark practice card. “3 mharc + 2 mharc” items are order-dependent (first correct point 3, second 2) and stay whole at 0/3/5; single answers with a printed partial (“= 3 mharc”) allow 0/3/5, otherwise 0/5.
Reading language: “Gaeilge lochtach: 0 - 5 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh” is one deduction from each 50-mark passage total; cards state it without applying it inside a part.

Prescribed prose (2A): Hurlamaboc (a) prints five 5-mark sub-questions: the whole option is a 25-mark card and every sub-question is also a practice card (“3 mharc + 2 mharc” sub-questions keep 0/3/5). Oisín i dTír na nÓg (b) is one 25-mark question (five points at 2 + 3). 2A(c) is a choose-one between two texts: Cáca Milis and An Lasair Choille are separate 25-mark cards (different topics).
Prescribed poetry (3A): each poem is a whole 25-mark card with (i) 8, (ii) 8, (iii) 9 and one 0–4 Gaeilge deduction; every printed sub-question is also a practice card.

Literature mark values: literature sub-questions other than “3 mharc + 2 mharc” keep the full range because the scheme’s points are indicative and further relevant points are credited “de réir a bhfiúntais”.

Optional prose (2B) and optional poetry (3B) stay whole: the text is open content chosen by the candidate. 2B(c) film or play shares one grid and one topic, so it stays one card with both printed alternatives.

Choose-two within 2A, 2B, 3A or 3B is a choice, not a route: each printed option keeps its own card and carries the instruction in its task requirements; no combination cards. The scheme marks each option on its own (no joint marking).
Q2A or Q2B and Q3A or Q3B are alternatives; scheme lists of sample answers are indicative answer keys, not route pools.
The modified marking scheme (PDF 33) changes language assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 2 = 200: Léamhthuiscint A 50 + B 50 (five questions of 10, each (a) 5 + (b) 5), Prós 50 (two of three at 25), Filíocht 50 (two of three at 25).
Reading A “Johnny Sexton – Laoch Rugbaí” (paper pages 4–5, scheme PDF 15–16) and B “Scéalta Móra 2022” (paper 6–7, scheme PDF 17–18).

Prescribed prose (paper 8): Hurlamaboc (i)–(v) at 5 each; Oisín i dTír na nÓg one 25-mark question; Cáca Milis or An Lasair Choille one 25-mark question (five points at 2 + 3). Optional prose (paper 9): (a) novel extract 23 (5, 5, 5, 4, 4) + title/author 2; (b) naming 1 + 22 + title 2; (c) film or play 23 (5, 5, 5, 4, 4) + title/writer 2.

Prescribed poetry (paper 10–12): Géibheann, An tEarrach Thiar, Mo ghrá-sa (idir lúibíní) at 8/8/9. Optional poetry (paper 13, all three modern poems): (a) 9 (5 + 4) / 7 (1 + 3 + 3) / 7 (1 + 3 + 3), (b) 9 (1 + 4 + 4) / 7 (1 + 3 + 3) / 7 (4 + 3), (c) 9 / 7 / 7, + 2 for poem and poet; the same poem may not be used twice.

Literature language: “[Gaeilge lochtach: 0-4 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh]” after every literature answer (Cáca Milis prints it with a closing full stop); it is a deduction from that answer, never inside one sub-question. The scheme prints no note after 3A(a) Géibheann (PDF 28); the SMM page (PDF 33) states the 0–4 rule for every Ceist 3 answer, so the Géibheann card keeps the deduction.

Scheme layout: each page’s boxed heading (“A – 50 marc”, “2A PRÓS AINMNITHE 50 marc” …) is stored at the end of the page in the text layer; the generator removes all eight so no heading lands inside an answer key.
Cover (PDF 1, printed as an image): the 2023 papers were adjusted to compensate for COVID-19 learning disruption. The cards follow the printed 2023 structure; the note offers no choice.

The legacy cards marked every literature answer as one 25-mark Eolas block (the Hurlamaboc key began at (iv), with (i)–(iii) missing) and every reading question as one 10-mark block; the 2A(c) card carried both texts. They now carry the printed part and sub-question tariffs, and 2A(c) is Cáca Milis.
